Subject: Demo request — Dedicated capacity for MarinerAI (throughput/latency)

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for Redwood's free tier last week and have been running some exploratory traffic. We're interested in a Dedicated capacity demo to understand throughput/latency tradeoffs — our app is very latency-sensitive (SLOs around 150–200ms tail for single-turn completions) and we expect peak concurrency of ~120 qps with bursts to 250 qps.

Primary asks:
- Can you show how Dedicated handles sustained 100–200 qps and what tail latency looks like?
- Options for prefix/kv caching and batching settings that won't violate our latency SLOs
- Quantization/instance recommendations for throughput vs cost

We can make time today or tomorrow morning PST. I've attached a short CSV with our qps profile and the feature set we'll exercise.

Thanks —
Sam
Head of ML Engineering
MarinerAI
